notes.title: Patch 2.0 available now!
notes.content:
This update has been planned for quite a long time and I am finally glad to present it to you. I'm not sure if there will be any more updates in the future, so I no longer know what special things I could contribute to this project.

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a new difficulty "Story Only" in which opponents no longer pay attention to the player, and do not cause any damage in story battles.
[*] At the beginning of a new game, you can choose the difficulty level
[*] Clouds are now more visible and moving faster
[*] During the rain, thunder rumbles less often, and the white color of the flash is replaced by gray
[*] Fixed graphical artifacts when scaling is enabled in Windows
[*] Cloud saves on Steam are now working
[/list]
The update is only available for Windows 64 bit.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 available now!
notes.content:
I am glad to present a new update introducing some changes into the gameplay.

[b]What's changed?[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor fixes for collisions
[*] Change loot in the first chests
[*] In the list of crafting the best items are on top
[*] On the equipment screen you can now switch the character without going to the main screen
[*] In the settings during the game you will have the opportunity to choose the speed of the battle
[/list]
Thank you for staying with us.

notes.title: To The Capital 2 is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]To The Capital 2[/b] is now live on Steam! It took almost 2 years to develop and finally we have reached this important event as the release of To The Capital 2!

Big thank you to everyone who has followed our project. I hope our game will give pleasure to fans of the genre of jRPG, and beginners in it.

notes.title: The demo version of To The Capital 2 is available!
notes.content:
Now we are moving to the next stage and working on the story, locations and gameplay. After all, what we have shown in the demo version is only a small part!

Thank you all for following our news!

notes.title: Combat system
notes.content:
A new video demonstrating an early version of the combat system is already here!

In total, the game will have about 60 abilities in four classes. For example, Ralph will be able to shower all enemies with arrows, and Luis will go into a rage by increasing his own damage, but losing some of his defense points.

Also, any player will be able to choose one of the three available difficulty levels. Fans of the plot and grind will be satisfied.

We are also working on a color palette about which we will write next week.

Thank you for watching the news!
